steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Signor, are you alright?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Just dreaming.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's why you shouldn't sleep on the sofa.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Where's the old man?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: The Don went to the theater.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Are you going too?
Leontuzzo does not answer, only sinking deeper into the sofa.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Rossati, Giovanna.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Cellinia, our original agreement was to ensure the Bellones come out on top.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: But, I've changed my mind.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: As long as you succeed, you don't owe us anything.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: At that point, you're free to go.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: This, I promise you as the Fang of Zaaro, il Signore dei Lupi.

a.text: From the time she returned to the residence at sunset, to the break of dawn the next day...
Listening to the falling rain, Texas wiped down her sword while reading the script that was handed to her—'La Morte di Texas.'
The story twists and turns, never straying far from what she's known.
But first, she needs to sharpen her sword.
Today, it may have to be a bit swifter than usual.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Tsk, tsk. The sun's still getting in my eyes, even though it's raining.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Prison food's not too bad. You should give it a try.

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: You're right about that. I've even given 'em a few suggestions before.

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Now get in the car.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Can I sit this one out?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Does killing a single Columbian really deserve so much fanfare?

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: The Don says Cellinia's gonna be there too.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What's the plan?

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: She'll pretend to be an actress, and once the performance starts, you'll improvise the rest.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hmm... So what about my costume?

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: What the Don meant was—

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: You wait in the audience and play along.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Oh, right. Haha.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What an insensitive old jerk. So where's he gonna be? He's not trying to find a nice place to watch the show all by himself, is he?

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: The Don has other business. He's got a meeting.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: A meeting?

steps.name: Loyal Mafioso
steps.text: Yeah, with a carwash worker.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Howdy, Sora. I just knew you'd be practicin' in Miss Caterina's studio.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I ain't gonna stop ya, but don'tha think you oughta head to the theater early? To do some makeup n' get ready n' whatnot?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yeah, you have a point.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Exusiai's already off to buy breakfast. We got just enough time to meet her.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Say... Didn't we say we'd set up a big ol' welcome for Exusiai's sister?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: We did.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But now I'm not sure we'll have enough time for that.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Croissant, watch your step!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? Wooooah!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Owwie...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'm fine, I'm fine. Just tripped on a little somethin'.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Dangit, I knocked over that stack of books. Lemme tidy 'em up.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh? A picture dropped outta somethin'.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Picture?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wait... Huh?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Lookie here!
It is a photograph from many years ago.
Sora can barely make out the background that should be of the wide and bustling streets of Columbia past.
In the center of the photograph stands a middle-aged man who wears a kind expression, but exudes an audacity not to be trifled with.
On his left and right sides stand a Lupo girl, and a Feline girl.
The girl on the left has beautiful blonde hair and sports a cheery expression, and even at a glance, one can immediately tell that she has a bubbly personality.
The girl on the right has black hair, her face betraying no emotions, making it difficult for one to guess the contents of her heart.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Look, this pitcher... ain't that... Texas, as a kid?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And standin' there with her... That's Caterina?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And look on the back here...
Written on the backside of the photo: 'Giovanna and Cellinia, 1080.'

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Giovanna... Is that gonna be Caterina's real name?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Giovanna... Giovanna Rossati.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: How long has this carwash been open?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Five years.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Five years? Coincidentally, that's how long my guard tuskbeast has been missing.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: If only I knew how he was doing these days.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: The city's a pretty big place. There's always a way to survive.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: It never made any sense to me before. I fed him plenty of meat, gave him a nice den. Why wasn't he happy?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Think he might've been vegetarian?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Maybe. Maybe it never knew how bad meat actually was until it tried a full-course meal.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: It's better to not eat at all... than to eat something bad.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Your car's done.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You're pretty good at your job.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: Practice makes perfect.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Heh. You never fail to get it done just right.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: But, Danbrown, nothing lasts forever.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: It's time for you to change your tastes.

steps.name: Carwash Worker
steps.text: ...I'll think about it.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Think carefully. Once you've figured it out, you're always welcome to come back.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Are you the backup bassist?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Oh, um... Is that your natural hair color?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: That's special. Usually, you have to dye your hair to work as a bassist. I've heard only those with Famiglia Texas blood have that eye and hair color.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: And, now that I'm seeing you up close, your eyebrows... look really similar to Salvadore's. Are you his bastard or something?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No, I have nothing to do with Texas.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: All sorts of coincidences out there, huh?

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Okay, take a seat over there. Your foundation's really good, so I should be able to get you squared away in no time.
Theater Box

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: Pardon me, are you satisfied with your seating?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Yes, I've got a fine view.

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: Excellent, excellent.

steps.name: Theater Manager
steps.text: If there's anything you need, please don't hesitate to call for me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Let's head down.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You're not going to stay and watch?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: You know I've never been a fan of this sort of stuff. How about I grab you a nice drink?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I'd like—

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Brandy, I know.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sorry I'm late!

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: No worries. Everyone's still getting ready.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Go ahead and take a seat. I'll do your makeup first.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: What's wrong? You don't look too well. Are you getting stage fright?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No, I'm fine.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Don't worry, Sora. You've been working so hard, everyone's gonna love you for sure!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I hope so.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Oh right, did you know...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Apparently, the bassist got sick and couldn't make it to the performance.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Huh? What are you going to do then?

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: It's no big deal. The director was able to find a stand-in. She's getting her makeup done in another dressing room right now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: A stand-in... Are you sure that's going to work?

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Just trust the director's judgment, alright?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Speaking of the director, he didn't come tonight?

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: He just dropped by to give some direction before leaving again. I think he's meeting with a guest.

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Important people are always so busy, huh?

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: But it's okay, Sora. You just need to play your part, that's all.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Onsite Staff
steps.text: Oh, if it isn't Judge Lavinia!

steps.name: Onsite Staff
steps.text: I haven't seen you here for a while. Have you come to watch tonight's opera?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No, I'm just passing by.

steps.name: Onsite Staff
steps.text: That's too bad. But, did you know we're putting on the highly-anticipated 'La Morte di Texas'? I'm sure you'll love it.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not in the mood.

steps.name: Onsite Staff
steps.text: That's alright then. I look forward to your next visit.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: (Danbrown? What's HE doing here?)

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: (Did he really... take my advice and come to the theater to unwind?)

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: (But, today's performance is...)

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Wait a second.

steps.name: Onsite Staff
steps.text: Oh, did you change your mind?

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: One ticket please.
Theater Box

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Don Bernardo, someone's here to see you.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: It's Rubio, Segretario di Sicurezza Alimentare.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Let him in.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Don Bernardo—

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: You can just call me 'director' here.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Ah, yes, yes. It's an honor to be here, Director.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Take a seat, Signor Segretario.

steps.name: Bernardo
steps.text: Let's enjoy the show first, then we'll talk.

steps.name: Announcer
steps.text: Signore e signori, thank you for being here tonight. You are about to see another spectacular performance brought to you by Compagnia dell'alba.

steps.name: Announcer
steps.text: 'La Morte di Texas,' Act II, written by Signorina Caterina.

steps.name: Announcer
steps.text: Every Siracusan already knows the story of Salvadore, but how many truly know the details?

steps.name: Announcer
steps.text: Signora Caterina, who has a deep understanding of Famiglia Texas, provides us with her frank yet intricate perspective.

steps.name: Announcer
steps.text: Let us delve deeper into the life of Salvadore!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Inhales deeply, then exhales.)

steps.name: Makeup Artist
steps.text: Break a leg, Sora!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Right, time to go!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Phew... Finally found them.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Attagirl, Sora scored us seats with a great view.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Great expectations for her, all around.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Excuse me, would you mind letting us through?
A Sankta girl... An unusual sight in Siracusa.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ehh? You're a Sankta too?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've been in Volsinii for a while, and this is the first time I've seen one of my people.
Hehe, looks like it's one good thing after another today.
Go right on by, child.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's weird... I don't sense any emotions from him. Is he a strayed Sankta?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But, he's unlike any of the other Sankta strays I've seen...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, whatever. By the way, am I the only one who thinks way too much of this crowd looks like mobsters?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I hear tell the head of the Rossati Family's here tonight.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, isn't that what you were just talking about?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yep. But let's just enjoy the show for now.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Singing) In an era when chaos and opportunity came hand-in-hand; some were swallowed by the tides of the times where others found in it their promised land.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Singing) Violence and wealth, power and order.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Singing) Onto Columbian soil steps a Siracusan, bringing with him only scars, hardship, and ambition.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: (Signing) And thus begins our tale. Ladies and gentlemen, come and bear witness, to whom this era truly belongs.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: That voice...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I see how it is. You're here to bring her back, aren't you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But do you really think that's going to happen?

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Who the hell are you?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Signore e signori, let the show begin!

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: It really is you, Cellinia.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Texas?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: —Ehh?
For a brief moment, Texas shifts her eyes to one of the boxes.
She knows Bernardo is sitting there, gazing down upon everything.
She feels it in her heart.
Whether coincidence or some form of necessity, in this moment, Sora is both a danger and a safe haven.
Everything depends on her.
The movement in the auditorium and the faint sounds in the distance all prelude the start of the assassination.
She gestures to Sora for her to stay silent, then proceeds to pluck the strings in her hands.
A most wonderful performance has begun.
